text: 科创50指数涨幅扩大至超8%，创业板指涨超5%，深成指涨3.6%，沪指涨1.7%。半导体行业ETF集体爆发，半导体ETF博时（159852 ）、半导体设备ETF招商（561980）、半导体设备ETF国泰（159516）等纷纷涨停，科创芯片ETF国泰（589100）、科创芯片ETF富国（588810）、科创芯片ETF博时（588990）等多只ETF涨超10%。
text_en: The STAR 50 Index's gain widened to more than 8%, the ChiNext Index rose more than 5%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 3.6%, and the Shanghai Composite Index rose 1.7%. Semiconductor industry ETFs collectively surged, with Bosera Semiconductor ETF (159852), China Merchants Semiconductor Equipment ETF (561980), Guotai Semiconductor Equipment ETF (159516) and others hitting the limit-up, while Guotai STAR Chip ETF (589100), Fullgoal STAR Chip ETF (588810), Bosera STAR Chip ETF (588990) and many other ETFs rose more than 10%.
